notes.title: Sign up for the Elevated Update playtest!
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers,

Since our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1757920/Astral_Flux/]last update[/url], we've been hard at work on the upcoming [i]Elevated[/i] update. Before it launches later this year, we’d love to hear what you think! Your feedback will help us make Elevated the best it can be. 

Playtest sign-ups are now open. Just head over to our main Steam page and hit the [i]request access button[/i]. We’ll be inviting players in waves as we move closer to launch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/plfcBkc.gif[/img]

If you want to learn more about the new update, we'd recommend reading our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1757920?emclan=103582791470811641&emgid=543347435698651506]dev diary[/url], which goes into detail about the new world, quality-of-life features, and whether you can pet the new Cosmocat!

Until next time,
AF Team

notes.title: Seeds of Doubt Update is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers,

We're incredibly excited to share that the Seeds of Doubt Update is now live. Like our previous updates, all players will be receiving this update for free.

The Seeds Of Doubt update adds an option to enter a random seed at the start of your run, thereby enabling you to repeat the same run, compete with others, etc. 

Along with this we’ve implemented what we call “The Invisible Hand”: a new system that will make the game slightly more forgiving to new players by offering them a helping hand when needed.

We can't wait to hear what you think!

Until next time,
AF Team

[h3]New Features[/h3][list][*] Display RNG seed on stats screen, add option for entering RNG seed in player ship
[*] Add friendly NPC cat in player ship
[*] Add option to delete unwanted artifacts[/list][h3]Balance Changes ⚖️[/h3]
[list][*] Bias artifacts towards positive
[*] Add a slight chance for jars to give useful items when near death[/list][h3]Improvements ⚒️[/h3]
[list][*] Disable compression for sprite atlases (AKA crisper pixel art)
[*] Improve Wrenchy “Help” text display
[*] Add one frame delay to level select to prevent accidental inputs
[*] Restarting run or ending game now requires holding button/key to prevent accidental restarts or endings[/list][h3]Bug Fixes 🐛[/h3]
[list][*] Fix responsiveness of loading screen tips
[*] Fix edge case where player could dash out of boss room
[*] Fix for Wrenchy interact text colour inconsistent
[*] Fix for exchangers not activated when dashing in front
[*] Fix edge case where level music would restart when visiting artifact room during escape sequence
[*] Fix for tutorial camera zoom inconsistent with main game
[*] Fix rare edge case where bosses wouldn't activate[/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Elevated Update
notes.notes:
Hey, it’s Adam from the Astral Flux team. Welcome to another devlog! In this devlog I’ll take you through some of the new content coming in our final two updates: Seeds of Doubt, and Elevated.
It probably goes without saying but this devlog contains spoilers, so if that’s a problem for you maybe consider reading with your eyes closed. 🫣

Let’s talk about the big update first: Elevated. This update will add another world, and similar to Submerged, we’re bringing you new boss mechanics, more advanced enemy AI, and dynamic environments.

[h2]Sky High[/h2]
Unlike other worlds, Elevated is set high in the sky, well above the planet. With this comes a new hazard: gravity. Where other worlds provide a safe landing at the bottom of the temple, this new world has no bottom, and one misstep could send you falling to your death!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7urAlUt.gif[/img]

To make things more interesting, we’ve also implemented a new type of level generation: rather than the winding paths of other worlds, the level is mainly open, and we’ve added jump pads to give you a boost to higher areas.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ft4986L.gif[/img]

[h2]The Daily Forecast[/h2]
In Submerged we explored a world with two distinct biomes: above and below water. For Elevated we’ve done something similar: a weather system with multiple distinct phases. When the level first starts you’ll be greeted by a colourful sunset with twinkling stars and layers of clouds gently blowing by.

As you hit switches the weather will become more and more stormy: the sky will darken, the wind will pick up, and the rain will intensify.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XgnjE9k.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O3A0dWg.gif[/img]

To make the world feel more alive we’ve added animated grass throughout. Naturally, the grass will sway faster as the storm picks up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a43fJAe.gif[/img]

[h2]Grab & Go[/h2]
Similar to Submerged this level will also feature a free roaming boss that spawns in once all three switches have been hit. Unlike Submerged, this boss will snatch you and carry you to its nesting area!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtDSc4Y.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZbZLD8W.gif[/img]

Once in the boss room you’ll be trapped, or so it seems at first, but one of the boss’s primary attacks is to grab rocks and drop them on you. Larger rocks will destroy the floor beneath you, providing you with an escape route back to the temple.

As with Submerged, fighting the boss is optional, but if you’re overzealous you might find yourself permanently trapped in the room!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tL9endG.gif[/img]

[h2]Liar, Liar, Ants On Fire[/h2]
Submerged introduced a new pathfinding system for underwater enemies. Naturally, we’ve taken full advantage of this in Elevated, but we’ve gone one step further: a new flying fire ant enemy with several distinct phases. It starts life as an egg which will hatch when you come near it. Initially it can fly around, pursuing the player. You’re able to defeat it during this phase, but if you’re not careful you may accidentally clip its wings. Doing so will cause it to drop to the ground, where it will leave a trail of fire in its wake!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o8VW3Bn.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VnxL2Y6.gif[/img]

[h2]Clinging To Life[/h2]
Since the focus of Elevated is on aerial movement, we’ve reduced the number of spikes in the level to make traversal more fluid. But you didn’t think we’d let you off the hook that easily? In place of spikes, we’ve introduced a new type of enemy that crawls around the level.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ziodqWx.gif[/img]

[h2]Testing, Testing[/h2]
One final bit of exciting news about Elevated: we want your feedback! We’ll be running a playtest early in the new year and we would encourage you to join. Keep an eye on the Steam store page for the sign-up button.

[h2]Sowing The Seeds Of Doubt[/h2]
Last but not least I wanted to give a quick mention to the smaller content update we’ll be pushing before Elevated. The Seeds Of Doubt update adds an option to enter a random seed at the start of your run, thereby enabling you to repeat the same run, compete with others, etc. We plan to run some competitions along with this update so stay tuned!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/849Ek6O.gif[/img]

Along with this we’ve implemented what we call “The Invisible Hand”: a new system that will make the game slightly more forgiving to new players by offering them a helping hand when needed. I won’t spoil it by mentioning the specifics of what this does, but if you found the game a little too difficult I would encourage you to give it another shot!

Oh, and don’t forget to pet the Cosmocat that accompanies you now in your spaceship. 😉

notes.title: Our free Submerged Update is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers,

It's finally here! We're incredibly excited to share that the Submerged Update is now live. Like our previous updates, all players will be receiving Submerged for free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290233/433c236458d5c531f9e3ced9744e0caba8604c7b.png[/img]
With this update, we're introducing a brand-new world, enemies, and a slew of bug fixes. Our new boss in particular will provide a challenge. You can find the full patch notes, with more information about the bug fixes, below. 

This has been a long time coming for the team and we can't wait to hear what you think.

Until next time,
AF Team


[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] A brand new world accessed through a branching path system. In this new world you will find:
[list]
[*] Unique underwater sections with separate biomes above and below the waterline
[*] Challenging new enemy mechanics, including more aggressive path-finding enemies
[*] A dangerous free roaming boss which you can either engage or try to evade. The choice is yours![/list][*] Mute SFX on pause[/list]
[b]Fixes 🐛[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix for D-pad input inconsistent in some menus
[*] Fix for ceiling robot spawning in platforms and getting stuck moving
[*] Fix for worms getting stuck
[*] Fix for broken stats menu in tutorial
[*] Turned off the mini-map during the tutorial
[*] Fix for ice worm moving too fast and landing in wall collider and getting stuck
[*] Fix for snail getting stuck
[*] Fix for ice worm getting stuck
[*] Fix falling spikes still hurting the player when landed on a falling bridge part
[*] Fix for barrels sometimes getting stuck in tilemap colliders in the wall when throwing barrels against walls
[*] Fix for spider getting stuck in wall[/list]

notes.title: Free Submerged Update and Switch Release on October 31st!
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers,

We're incredibly excited to announce that our next free update "Submerged" will be released on October 31st! In Submerged, you will travel to a brand-new planet filled with ancient horrors and discover dangerous new enemies that lurk in the water.

Our new trailer will give you a first look at the exciting adventures that await.

[previewyoutube=qKxccrYbzQU;full][/previewyoutube]
Additionally, we will be bringing the full game—including Submerged—to Nintendo Switch on October 31st. Switch players can already try our free demo right now. 

We can't wait to dive into Submerged very soon! 

Until next time,
AF Team

notes.title: New Update Available Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers,

Cosmocat is excited to announce that we’ve joined forces with the publisher Mindscape to continue developing Astral Flux together!

With today’s update, a free demo is now available, new languages have been added to the game, alongside a plethora of bug fixes and quality-of-life features. This update has been a huge undertaking for the team, and we have even more content coming soon!

Following the successful releases of the [i]Artifact Hunter[/i] and [i]Balance of Power[/i] updates, the next free update, [i]Submerged[/i], will introduce an underwater planet filled with ancient horrors and dangerous new enemies. 

We can’t wait for you to see everything that Submerged has to offer!

Until next time,
AF Team

[b]New Features[/b]

[*] Add full input rebinding system for keyboard and gamepad. [b]Note: most input actions only have one default assignment now; if you were relying on any of the old defaults you will need to use the new system and rebind the controls to your preference![/b]

[b]Changes ⚖️[/b]

[b]Improvements ⚒️[/b]

notes.title: Submerged Update: Closed Beta
notes.notes:
Greetings interdimensional adventurers, we come bearing good news! Our next free update to Astral Flux is nearing completion. Nathan has prepared a video devlog outlining what you can expect to see in the Submerged update:

[previewyoutube=aN7g0O5ch0w;full][/previewyoutube]
We will be beta testing the update from December 17 until early next year. Existing players are encouraged to sign up and will receive priority. We are also inviting new players (you will be provided with a key), but we have limited space.

If you’re interested you can [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1r8te_EW3Pf3-AIkOJAOSSd52rPGK2elbRJQNay7DtOs/viewform]sign up here[/url]! Space is limited so please sign up early to secure your spot. Submissions will close on December 16.

Safe travels,
AF Team

notes.title: Artifact Hunter Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the second major update to Astral Flux is now available!

[previewyoutube=QIHPxLHr9Cc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Features 🙌[/h2]
[list]
[*] New achievement: Artifact Hunter!
[*] New temple escape mechanic: world destroyers
[*] New mechanic: artifact system! Discover randomized artifacts during your runs, apply gameplay modifiers in subsequent runs. (See devlog for full details)
[*] New stats UI and large minimap display (press Tab key or Back button to access)
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes/Improvements 🐛[/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor visual updates to tutorial scene
[*] Fix for some enemies remaining passive when aggroed
[*] Update damage upgrade descriptions to be more clear
[*] Fix for player walk animation remaining active during certain situations (teleporting, etc)
[*] Make player invincible during teleportation
[*] Fix some enemy navigation issues
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes ⚖️[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chance of enemies spawning in aggro state
[*] Enemies now aggro when hit
[*] Tweak enemy spawn logic (The enemy difficulty spawn curve was not properly evaluated in previous builds; this has been corrected)
[/list]

notes.title: Balance of Power Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
Today's the day! The Balance of Power is now available!

[list]
[*] Fix for player bullets not colliding with indestructible tiles
[*] Fix for enemy bullets not colliding with indestructible tiles nor destructible tiles

[*] Partial fix for final boss phase not cancelled immediately on death

[*] More feedback for ground robot attack
[*] Fix for long HUD text wrapping (time, coins)

[*] Revise final boss room layout

notes.title: Build 7 release notes
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who helped make the release a success! We’re pleased to announce the first post-release update. This update clears up a few release bugs, improves onboarding, and makes several balancing updates that we believe will bring the difficulty more in line with your expectations.

[b]New Features 🙌[/b]
[list]
[*] New custom adaptive final boss music
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes/Improvements 🐛[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosions now have a 50% chance of causing ceiling enemies to drop
[*] Allow pausing in player ship
[*] Increase hitbox size for world 1 boss
[*] Various minor audio and visual fixes
[*] Start world 2 boss faster to minimize chance of player walking into swords
[*] Close final boss gate faster to minimize chance of player trapping themselves outside
[*] Potential performance optimization (pause some distant off-screen enemies to reduce CPU/physics load)
[*] Add HUD feedback when collecting oxygen, coins, and activating switches
[*] Improve usability of oxygen refill stations by clearly showing coins -> oxygen exchange details
[*] Spikey enemies can now be killed via explosions
[*] Fix some issues with physics-based coins
[*] Fix for world 1 boss not always taking damage
[*] Fix for player stuck moving slowly after holding exploding barrel
[*] Fix various scenarios in which player could remain in the shooting state
[*] Fix for pausing during teleporting leaving player frozen
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increase world 1 boss health, add ceiling worms
[*] Fix for world 3 boss head health not refilling fully after each phase
[*] Decrease probability of bottles spawning hearts and oxygen (50% -> 33%)
[*] 50% chance of chests being trapped
[*] Remove item spawns for world 1 and 2 bosses
[*] Increase difficulty of challenge rooms
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1757920/discussions/0/5230393378279517328/]this forum post[/url] for known issues with the latest build

P.S. We will soon be posting a devlog with our plans for the future. We have lots of cool stuff in the works and we’re excited to share! Stay tuned...
